newsitem.title: USA: Harrah's Jazz DIP financing capped at $30/m.
newsitem.headline: Harrah's Jazz DIP financing capped at $30/m.

text.p: Harrah's Jazz Co said Friday Harrah's Entertainment Inc, its parent company, is not prepared to extend debtor in possession financing beyond September 30 or its provision of a total of $30 million.

Harrah's Jazz said, therefore, that its ability to consummate its plan of reorganization and resume constructing its land-based casino may be hurt if it can't obtain debtor in possession financing beyond that date or amount.
Harrah's Entertainment said, in its notice to Harrah's Jazz, that it has already loaned more than $24 million of the $30 million in debtor in possession financing authorized by the bankruptcy court.
Harrah's Entertainment said it provided notice at this time to give Harrah's Jazz the opportunity to explore its alternatives.

After the Louisiana Legislature did not approve the terms of an amended casino operating contract last month, Harrah's Jazz filed with the bankruptcy court a proposal to modify its plan of reorganization.
